notes.title: Update v1.2 Release Notes
notes.content:
- Added SlowMo Button
If things get a little out of control, hit the 
slowMo button! Check out the How To Play section
for more info 

- Do a barrel roll!
Barrel roll left and right to get through those tight
spaces. Check out the How To Play section for more 
info

- Adjusted Beat Detection
Ship speed and cube spawning algorithms have 
been tuned to fit the music better, get immersed!
